title: Nurturing Irish Rice Pilaf
description: A grassy, crisp Irish rice pilaf cooked on a cedar plank. It blends earthy greens and dried cranberries for a macrobiotic-friendly dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place a cedar-plank on the prepared sheet and lightly oil it with a small amount of olive oil.
Rinse brown rice under cold water until clear, then drain.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until softened, about 4 minutes.
Stir in rinsed rice, vegetable broth, thyme, salt, and pepper; bring to a simmer.
Transfer the rice mixture onto the cedar plank, spreading it evenly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, then remove and stir in kale, cranberries, and parsley; return to oven for another 10 minutes until rice is tender and liquid absorbed.
Remove from oven, let rest 5 minutes, then sprinkle toasted sesame seeds if using.
Slice the cedar plank into serving portions and serve warm.
